name: proyecto-final
description: Sistema distribuido para un videojuego multijugador

scripts.start: concurrently "npm run start:auth" "npm run start:coord:a" "npm run start:coord:b" "npm run start:coord:c" "npm run start:client"
scripts.start:auth: cd auth-service && npm rebuild better-sqlite3 && node index.js
scripts.start:coord:a: cd coordinator && cross-env PORT=5000 PEER_PORT=5001 COORDINATOR_ID=coord-A PUBLIC_URL=ws://localhost:5000 PEER_URL=ws://localhost:5001 node index.js
scripts.start:coord:b: cd coordinator && cross-env PORT=5002 PEER_PORT=5003 COORDINATOR_ID=coord-B PUBLIC_URL=ws://localhost:5002 PEER_URL=ws://localhost:5003 node index.js
scripts.start:coord:c: cd coordinator && cross-env PORT=5004 PEER_PORT=5005 COORDINATOR_ID=coord-C PUBLIC_URL=ws://localhost:5004 PEER_URL=ws://localhost:5005 node index.js
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd auth-service && npm install && cd ../coordinator && npm install
